repairPrompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit
Asset type: repaired game sprite atlas for an existing tower defense game.
Image 1 is the EDIT TARGET: a 5-column by 3-row contact sheet of the game's existing 15 towers. Repair these exact towers; do not redesign them.
Primary request: deliver a clean production sprite sheet with EXACTLY these 15 towers in the exact same row-major order on a GENUINELY TRANSPARENT alpha background. Keep 5 equal columns and 3 equal rows. Each whole tower must fit inside its own cell with at least 10% empty padding, including barrel tips, flame tops, coils and complete solid pedestal bottoms.
Row 1: golden dart launcher pointing right, blue ice crystal fortress, purple electric coil Zap, long silver sniper pointing down-left, green poison vat with side nozzle.
Row 2: gold coin vault Bank, cyan orb coil Tesla, orange flame brazier Fire, cyan upward-chevron Haste, yellow crystal Power.
Row 3: purple black-hole Void tower, green armored barracks Guard, twin gold cannon Ranger, long dark blue railgun pointing down-left, silver orbital dish with blue beam emitter.
Repair missing/cropped barrel tips and clipped tower tops. Fill every structural surface with complete opaque material: dark metal is DARK METAL, not transparent holes. Tower walls, barrels, platforms and structural parts must be solid and fully coloured. Preserve the precise design language, isometric viewpoint, weapon direction, original colors, proportions and mechanical detail of each reference tower. Keep dark metal readable with modest silver edge highlights.
Remove the number-1 shield badges completely; replace badge areas with matching continuous pedestal/trim. The game draws live level badges separately. Remove stray pieces of neighboring towers at the bottom of cells. No background panels, no floor, no cast shadows, no text or numbers. Isolated cutouts. Gentle local glow only around energy/fire, not blurred towers. All bases are complete flat-bottomed pedestals for sitting on the ground.
DO NOT draw a checkerboard pattern. Empty space must have actual alpha=0. Do not remove black/dark solid material inside towers. Crisp clean sprite edges, no blur. All fifteen existing towers retained, no new towers, no duplicates.
transparencyPrompts: Use case: background-extraction. Edit target: this 15-tower sprite sheet. Remove ONLY the baked grey and white checkerboard background and output GENUINE TRANSPARENT ALPHA. The checkerboard in the supplied PNG is opaque RGB, not transparency. Empty space must be alpha=0, not grey/white squares. Preserve every tower exactly as drawn, all solid black and dark grey metals must stay fully OPAQUE; do NOT erase dark metal. Preserve the five-column three-row arrangement, all 15 designs, colours, dimensions, positions, complete bases, barrel tips, energy accents. No redesign, no new background, no shadows, no text. Critical: remove checkerboard INCLUDING gaps between energy arcs and towers. Deliver transparent PNG.

Extract the 15 tower sprites from the supplied sheet into a transparent PNG sprite sheet. BACKGROUND MUST BE TRANSPARENT. Remove the checkerboard completely. Use image transparency, not a visual representation of transparency. The supplied grey and white squares are unwanted background pixels and must disappear. Output RGBA PNG with alpha=0 outside the objects. Preserve the 5 by 3 grid and exact tower artwork. Keep dark metal opaque. Do not add any background at all.
notes: All 15 existing tower designs repaired, badges removed, genuine alpha preserved. Individually cropped and normalized to a 256px canvas with pedestal contact at (128,240). Original assets retained in ../tower-ui.
